reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: Remote work has fundamentally transformed urban development patterns over the past decade. As companies embrace flexible work arrangements, employees increasingly relocate away from expensive city centers to suburban and rural areas. This shift reduces demand for downtown office space, prompting real estate developers to convert commercial buildings into residential apartments. Consequently, housing prices in previously affordable regions have surged, creating new socioeconomic challenges. However, this decentralization also revitalizes smaller towns through increased local spending and infrastructure investment, suggesting that remote work's impact on urban landscapes is complex and multifaceted.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one consequence of remote work adoption?
options: Increased demand for downtown office space
Conversion of commercial buildings to residential use
Decreased housing prices in suburban areas
Reduced investment in infrastructure
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '원격근무로 인해 도시 중심가 사무실 수요가 감소하고, 개발자들이 상업용 건물을 주거용 아파트로 전환한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage imply about smaller towns due to remote work?
options: They experience only negative economic effects
They benefit from increased local spending
They lose population to city centers
They cannot attract businesses
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 부분에서 '이러한 분산화는 지역 지출 증가와 인프라 투자를 통해 작은 도시들을 활성화한다'고 설명합니다.

questions.q: Which of the following best describes the author's view on remote work's impact?
options: Entirely positive
Entirely negative
Complex with both benefits and challenges
Insignificant and negligible
questions.explanation: 본문 마지막 문장에서 '원격근무의 도시에 대한 영향은 복잡하고 다면적이다'라고 표현하여 긍정적 측면과 부정적 측면을 모두 인정합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work should be the primary work model for all companies in the future'? Provide specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시: 동의하는지 반대하는지를 직접 표현하고, 이유를 간단히 미리 제시하기
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 근거 제시 (원격근무의 장점: 생산성, 비용 절감, 직원 만족도 등) 또는 (단점: 소통 부족, 팀 빌딩 어려움 등) 구체적 예시 포함
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 근거 제시 (산업별 차이, 직무 특성 고려 등) 반대 의견 인정하면서도 입장 강화
structure.conclusion: 입장 재확인 및 전체 요점 요약, 미래 전망이나 제언으로 마무리

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work should not be universally applied...
I strongly believe that companies should adopt hybrid models...
One significant advantage of remote work is...
However, it is important to acknowledge that...
Furthermore, different industries have different requirements...
In conclusion, a flexible and balanced approach is essential...

speaking.prompt: Some people believe that cities should invest heavily in public transportation. Others think that improving roads for personal vehicles is more important. Which position do you agree with more, and why?
useful_expressions: In my perspective, public transportation is more beneficial because...
One compelling reason is that public transit reduces traffic congestion...
Additionally, investing in public transportation is more environmentally friendly...
While some argue that road improvement benefits drivers, I believe...
To summarize my position, public transportation offers broader societal benefits...
sample_points: 공공 교통 투자의 환경적 이점: 개인 차량 대비 탄소 배출량 감소, 도시 대기 오염 감소, 지속 가능한 발전 실현
경제적 효율성: 도로 확장보다 대중교통이 비용 효율적, 저소득층 시민의 이동성 개선, 장기적 도시 발전 촉진

listening.title: University Advising Session
listening.script: Advisor: Good morning! I see you're interested in changing your major from Business to Environmental Science. Tell me what motivated this decision. Student: Well, I took an environmental biology course last semester, and it really opened my eyes to climate change and sustainability issues. I feel like I want to make a real difference in addressing these problems. Advisor: That's great motivation. However, I need to mention that switching majors at this point might delay your graduation by a year or so. You'd need to complete additional science prerequisites and core environmental courses. Student: I understand, but I think it's worth it. I'm not just pursuing a degree for a job anymore; I want to work on something I'm passionate about. Advisor: That's a mature perspective. Let me show you the course requirements and help you plan a realistic timeline. We can also explore internship opportunities with environmental organizations to strengthen your portfolio. Sound good? Student: Absolutely. Thank you so much for being supportive about this.

questions.q: Why does the student want to change their major?
options: Business major is too difficult
They discovered a passion for environmental science through a course
They want to graduate faster
The advisor recommended the change
questions.explanation: 학생이 '지난 학기 환경생물학 과정을 들었는데 기후변화와 지속가능성 문제에 눈을 떴다'고 명시적으로 말합니다.

questions.q: What is a potential consequence of changing majors according to the advisor?
options: The student will fail some courses
Graduation may be delayed by approximately one year
The student won't be able to find employment
The university will charge additional fees
questions.explanation: 어드바이저가 '이 시점에서 전공을 바꾸면 졸업이 약 1년 정도 늦어질 수 있다'고 명확히 설명합니다.

questions.q: What does the advisor offer to help the student?
options: A full refund of tuition
Course requirements planning and internship opportunities
A job guarantee in environmental companies
Exemption from prerequisite courses
questions.explanation: 어드바이저가 학생에게 '강좌 요구사항을 보여주고 현실적인 타임라인을 계획하며 환경 조직의 인턴십 기회를 탐색할 것'을 제안합니다.
